notes:
Reached by direct fetch (Shopify storefront, Bloomreach-powered PLP grid). PLP HTML ships an empty grid, so every count was read from the rendered listing header ('N Items') via the r.jina.ai reader, and independently cross-checked against Bloomreach core.dxpapi.com (account_id=7981, domain_key=arhaus_us, search_type=category) response.numFound. Contrary to the batch note, dxpapi answered HTTP 200 from here and agreed with the rendered header on 23 of 23 leaf categories. Hierarchy follows the site mega-menu. Excluded per scope rules: Light Bulbs; Flatware; Kitchen Accessories; Table Linens; Candles & Home Fragrance (22 items - almost entirely scented candles and reed diffusers); Faux Botanicals; Games; Jewelry; Baskets; Wallpaper; Hooks & Wall Organization (functional hardware incl. toilet-paper holders); all bath categories (Bath Mirrors, Bath Accents & Decor, Bath Accessories); all furniture, rugs, textiles, pillows, bedding and outdoor furniture. Kitchen Lighting (68), Bath Lighting (98) and Picture Lights (8) were dropped after pid-set analysis proved each is a 100% subset of the primary lighting product-type categories - they are room/use cross-cut views, not distinct categories, and would double-count. Likewise /collections/lamps (128) is exactly Table+Floor+Desk Lamps, and /collections/decorative-objects (132) is a mixed roll-up wholly inside Home Decor & Accessories. Arhaus publishes no clocks category (wall clocks appear only inside broader decor roll-ups).

RULE 0 TOP-UP ADDENDUM (2026-08-10): Re-visited the site live (r.jina.ai now Cloudflare-challenged from this environment; direct fetch of collection URLs still returns HTTP 200 with an empty grid, so verification was done with claude-in-chrome rendering the pages plus /collections/<handle>/products.json paged enumeration as an independent cross-check). Restored 4 rows the pre-Rule-0 pass had explicitly dropped/blanket-excluded as room-word cross-cuts, per Rule 0.6 ('two genuine nav branches - emit both, document overlap' - overlap is not grounds to drop): Kitchen Lighting (67, was 68 - linked from the Lighting hub's own sub-nav, not the header mega-menu), Bath Lighting (97, was 98 - linked from both the Lighting hub and the Bath hub), Picture Lights (8, unchanged - linked from the Lighting hub sub-nav), and Bath Mirrors (9, newly added - the site's own Mirrors mega-menu lists it as a sibling of Floor/Wall/Decorative Mirrors, and it is decorative bath wall mirrors only, no medicine cabinets/hardware). Checked the full site mega-menu (probe.py nav dump of the Lighting hub page, which returns the whole header nav) for any other room-based lighting/mirror branch not yet captured - none found: no separate Vanity Lighting, Bedroom Lighting, Recessed/Track/Under-cabinet Lighting, Vanity/Makeup/LED-Backlit Mirror collections exist on this site; the Bath sub-nav has exactly one Lighting node and one Mirrors node, both now captured. Bath Accents & Decor and Bath Accessories remain correctly excluded - not lighting or mirror product types, out of this top-up's scope. All 4 new rows carry a MANUAL REVIEW flag documenting the Rule 0 rationale and pid-overlap with existing type-tree lighting/mirror rows, not because the qty itself is in doubt (all 4 were verified two independent ways and agreed within 1 unit). No other row in the file was touched.
